D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Jared Huffman leads by 51.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 134,891 votes; a one point swing is about 1,304 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +44.3 and D +58.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 1.0 points toward Jared Huffman. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.
